# people.revoledu.com

> > Educational resource hub featuring Kardi Teknomo's comprehensive tutorials and research on data science, machine learning, and computational algorithms.

This site hosts academic and educational content focused on data science, machine learning algorithms, and mathematical optimization. It features interactive calculators, tutorials, and research publications by Kardi Teknomo, a prominent researcher in pedestrian simulation and urban modeling.

## Key Topics

- Kardi Teknomo
- Machine Learning
- Data Science Algorithms
- Principal Component Analysis (PCA)
- Neural Networks
- Game Theory
- Nash Equilibrium
- Linear Programming
- Decision Trees
- Hierarchical Clustering
- Optimization Methods
- Python
- Excel Add-ins
- Interactive Labs
- Educational Resources

## Core Tutorials & Learning Materials

- [Kardi Teknomo's Tutorial](https://people.revoledu.com/kardi/tutorial): Comprehensive tutorials on data science, machine learning, and pattern recognition algorithms
- [Game Theory Calculator](https://people.revoledu.com/kardi/tutorial/GameTheory/GameTheory.html): Interactive Game Theory Calculator exploring Nash Equilibrium and strategic analysis

## Research & Publications

- [Kardi Teknomo's Selected Publications](https://people.revoledu.com/kardi/publication/research-topics.htm): Kardi Teknomo's research publications on pedestrian simulation and urban modeling

## Optional Resources

- [List of Animals A to Z with pictures from Google Image](https://people.revoledu.com/john/Animal/index.html): Alphabetical animal reference with images from Google Image search
- [Christian](https://people.revoledu.com/kardi/personal/christian.htm): Personal Christian faith and Bible study resources and devotional content
